mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in labor market conditions, measured by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals strong economic growth that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 195), a decline in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals reduced purchasing power and weak demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 195 and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the signal in high inflation regimes is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly housing starts (HOUST) fall below 2000 thousand units, it indicates a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 2000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) signal a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO and GDPC1 both decline, or the Rank IC for the joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regimes (INDPRO < 100), a further decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening economic conditions that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the signal in manufacturing slowdown regimes is below 0.03.
